question: Demand elasticity / AIDS
method: Deaton–Muellbauer demand system; adding-up, homogeneity and symmetry
limitation: No harmonized household/category prices and expenditure panel. GDP and food production cannot substitute. Acquire surveys, test restrictions and hold out regions.
decision: Product mix, affordability, pack and price choices

question: Trade gravity / PPML
data_needed: Bilateral HS quantities/values, tariffs and structural access
method: Santos Silva–Tenreyro PPML; origin/destination-time and pair effects as identified
limitation: Single Nigeria HS1001 preview has missing net weight; broad WDI imports do not identify attainable capture. Acquire bilateral product flows and access controls.

question: Supply benchmark / OLS
method: Lagged growth pooled OLS, country CR1 clustering
status: Executed and rejected for investment use
limitation: Training 2002–2018; retrospective 2019–2022 holdout. Tiny gain, target mismatch, instability; no causal or 2051 forecast.
decision: Retain benchmark and prioritize actual product/operating evidence

question: FX/commodity volatility
data_needed: Aligned procurement currency, commodity, basis and hedge series
method: Engle ARCH/GARCH; Granger cointegration/error correction where suitable
limitation: No matching exposure series or hedge basis. Tests must establish stationarity, breaks and forecast value.
decision: Hedge, collateral, pass-through and liquidity design

question: Crop/climate impact
data_needed: Geocoded crops, calendars, hazards, water and adaptation
method: Crop-process model or identified yield/weather response; IPCC informs mechanisms
limitation: Country water stress and global climate assessment cannot price actual assets. Obtain basin/asset hazards and adaptation costs.
decision: Origin, backup, adaptation or no-go decisions

question: Marketing / causal lift
data_needed: Randomized or credible matched route/customer data
method: Randomized cluster ITT; modern DID for nonrandom timing with pre-trends/overlap
limitation: Sample/power need baseline variance and ICC. Record noncompliance, spillover, cannibalisation, attrition and sustained paid repeat.
decision: Spend, service, price/pack and scaling decisions

question: Customer repeat
data_needed: Linked customer orders, promotion and actual collections
method: Cohort/survival or hierarchical model, validated by customer/time holdout
limitation: No linked customer panel; repeated shipments may be loading rather than paid adoption.

question: DCF / cash
data_needed: Chosen normalized physical volume, price, cost, capex and credit inputs
method: FCFF identity; finite discounted sum; investment order root
limitation: 18 matched mode/world cases, actual taxes/FX/monthly cash absent; 195 country cases remain threshold-only.

question: Robust/adaptive allocation
data_needed: Feasible actions, state payoffs, budgets and learning
method: Minimax regret; CVaR; Bayesian EVSI; constrained network LP
limitation: Chosen payoffs, priors and dependencies. No empirically optimal all-country allocation or mathematical novelty.
decision: Capped experiments, staged commitments and network constraints
